theorems.name: Submission.rsd_isIntegerMultiplicity_int_combination
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = (p₁ : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (p₂ : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
